about_the_game:
Hikari Kamikura is a second-year high school student.
She has transferred to a school as many times as her age, and in April, she transferred to Heisei High School.
She has never had any long-lasting friends because she has transferred to a school so often, but this time, she felt something was different.

On the morning of her first day of school, she witnesses a boy who confessed his love and got rejected within a second.
The moment she saw this, she was shocked like never before.

"Maybe I'll make friends, if I support their love!!"

Boys and girls are at an age where they are curious about love.
She has an idea that if she helps everyone with their love, they will surely become her friends.
A simple but unprecedented plan is about to begin.


  • All 30 characters are main characters.
  • Collect information, persuade your classmates, and use the Pieces you obtain to support their romance.
  • There is no game over and the story structure makes it easy for anyone to play.
  • Enjoy the world of Heisei High School with its fast-paced story and direction.


  • All graphics are now in Full HD.
  • Achievements feature implemented.
    If you spot Takoyaki CHAN at the Heisei Festival...
  • New rewards have been added for clearing the game.
    Unused illustrations and music in the main game will be unlocked.
  • Minor improvements have been added to the options.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 / 10
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen series, Intel Core i series, or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 1280x720, 32-bit colors, Vertex shader 2.0, Pixel shader 2.0
  • DirectX: Version 9.0c
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectSound compliant device
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 1920x1080

short_description: A manga-style visual novel game featuring 30 high school students. Hikari Kamikura races around Heisei High School in an attempt to change her friendless situation!
